summary: Replaces the text buffer content of an edit control with a new string. Returns -1 when a2 is null or identical to the current buffer. Otherwise truncates and copies a2 into the buffer (at most this[190]-1 bytes), filters out characters rejected by the field-type validator sub_48B560, repositions the cursor pointer this[189] to the end of the resulting string, and triggers a vtable render-update call, returning 0.

operations.description: Early-return -1 when the input string a2 is null.
Early-return -1 when a2 equals the current buffer at this[188] (no change).
Compute the maximum copy length as this[190] - 1 (buffer end limit 0x2F8-derived slot, one byte reserved for the terminator).
Copy a2 into the buffer v4 with truncation to the length limit via sub_587DD0.
Force the NUL terminator at v4[this[190] - 1].
Walk the copied string from this[188]; truncate the string at the first character rejected by the validator sub_48B560 (sets *v6 = 0).
Reset the cursor pointer this[189] to the buffer start this[188].
Advance the cursor pointer this[189] to the end of the string (past the terminating NUL).
Indirect call through the vtable (this[0] + 44) with argument 1 to request a render update of the edit control.
